observations.note: The agent tried an inline `python3 -I -c "print(1)"` shell command, which the phase prompt forbids and which was denied, before falling back to Edit for the plan marks.
The prompt asks for all completed marks in one edit of the plan, but the agent made five separate Edit calls (one failed on a string mismatch), and the digest flags the repeats.
Step 8 says to write the completed marks of the phase in one edit, not one edit per row, and the agent edited the plan once per row.
About 52k tokens were read before the first write, mostly the 40k-character plan that includes other phases' rows, though peak context stayed low at 55k.

conformance.item: Read the phase rows in the plan, then the triage note, then the files the rows name
Build only rows with empty Completed cell; leave other marks as they are
Write tests first and see them fail for the right reason
Test carries the criterion id in name or comment
Run only the test files the rows name, as plain commands
Write the completed marks in one edit of the plan
Shell: plain single commands only, no inline python -c
Check specs touched by the changed files that the plan does not name
Set plan status to in-progress when it is planned
Hand over phase_note as the final ARTIFACT line
